t.name: Vedder Mountain
t.dir: Off of Trans-Canada Hwy heading South on Vedder Road for +/- 5.5 km. Will then merge onto Vedder Mountain Road for +/- 7.1 km. Then heading south again on Cultus Lake Road for +/- 2.3 km which will merge onto Columbia Valley Road for +/- 3.8 km and onto Parmenter Road for +/- 6.0 km. Next onto Vedder Mountain Forest Service Road for +/- 3.6 km. You will then be at the head of the trail access.
